contents.keyRoles: Key roles in the criminal justice system
section.keyRoles.heading: Key roles in the criminal justice system
section.keyRoles.intro: To better support you, we've provided information on the various roles and responsibilities within the criminal justice system.
role.courtUshers.heading: Court Ushers
role.courtUshers.body: They prepare the court room and ensure that witnesses, defendants, and lawyers are present.
role.cpsprosecutors.heading: Crown Prosecution Service (CPS) Prosecutors
role.cpsprosecutors.body: They decide whether to bring cases to court and prosecute criminal cases on behalf of the state.
role.defenceSolicitors.heading: Defence Solicitors and Barristers
role.defenceSolicitors.body: They represent the accused, ensuring their legal rights are protected and providing a defence in court.
role.judgesMagistrates.heading: Judges and Magistrates
role.judgesMagistrates.body: They oversee court proceedings, make rulings on legal matters, and ensure trials are conducted fairly.
role.legalAdvisers.heading: Legal Advisers
role.legalAdvisers.body: A lawyer who advises magistrates and guides proceedings.
role.policeOfficers.heading: Police Officers
role.policeOfficers.body: They investigate crimes, make arrests, and ensure public safety. The officer in charge is responsible for overseeing the case.
role.policeWitnessCareofficers.heading: Police Witness Care Officers
role.policeWitnessCareofficers.body: They provide key updates about the progress of the case after somebody is charged through to a court outcome.
role.probationOfficers.heading: Probation Officers
role.probationOfficers.body: They supervise offenders in the community, helping them reintegrate into society while ensuring they comply with the terms of their release.
role.victimCaseworkers.heading: Victim Caseworkers, Advocates, and Support Workers
role.victimCaseworkers.body: These professionals provide support and assistance to victims of crime, helping them navigate the criminal justice process.
role.witnessServiceVolunteers.heading: Witness Service Volunteers
role.witnessServiceVolunteers.body: They give practical help to someone when going to court to give evidence.
